authority_scope: Owns the AIBL Cap fork product source for the open source screen recording platform, including desktop, web, CLI, browser extension, self-hosting, and shared media/application code. It does not own Company Hub catalog routing, Team HQ intake, private recordings or credentials, or the unresolved upstream/fork policy.
notes: Company Hub is the catalog and routing projection for this repository, while Team HQ remains readable and accepts existing work. The repository is a public AIBL Cap fork and product source for open source screen recording, sharing, desktop, web, CLI, browser extension, and self-hosting work. Cap supports owning storage, self-hosting, local recordings, public or private sharing, passwords, custom domains, and keeping sensitive recordings off hosted infrastructure. The upstream/fork policy and why the stable branch is the provider default remain unresolved authority items.
